Confidence Score: 5/5

**[Medium impact]** The PR appears safe to merge; no actionable issues were found.

Summary

Makes saved PDF history available before the iframe’s `onLoad` handler runs. - PDF viewers can read their saved position before the iframe loads. No actionable issues found. Tests were not run.

Diagram

 ```mermaid %%{init: {'theme': 'neutral'}}%% flowchart LR A[Client loads saved history] --> B[Parent window stores history by note and context] C[PDF.js asks for history] --> D{Injected history exists?} D -->|Yes| E[Use injected history] D -->|No| B B --> F[Restore saved PDF position] ```
